messages:
maya: Quick flag from billing smoke runs: invoice-preview token totals jumped ~2.7% for requests routed through policy=multi-model since yesterday's routing policy change. Not in per-request logs.

tom: I dug a bit. Streaming path emits interim token events (stream_chunk) and the finalizer emits finalize_token. Both go to metering. Our dedupe used fingerprint+window+route in v1 keys. If route flips during processing (policy fallback) we end up double-counting.

priya: Example simplified: stream event -> route=multi-model, finalize -> route=fallback-small. Same fingerprint, different route -> different dedupe key -> counted twice. Saw this for a handful of tenants.

dan: ugh. we introduced route tag into dedupe earlier to avoid cross-tenant collisions when fingerprints reused, but route is orthogonal for dedupe correctness.

maya: short-term mitigation request: can we suppress stream_chunk events from metering if a finalize arrives within X seconds? cheap debounce.

priya: possible. Another safer path: ship a schema extension that adds canonical_fingerprint and dedupe_schema_version. Aggregator prefers canonical_fingerprint when present. Ingest lib can start emitting canonical_fp quickly via a header.

nate: propose rollout plan: 1) aggregator accepts canonical_fp but keeps old logic; 2) enable canonical_fp dedupe in canary cluster (5% tenants) behind flag; 3) run 24h shadow compare, calculate invoice delta; 4) ramp if stable.

ingest-bot: alert: schema:v3 rollout status: ~92% of edge nodes emitting canonical_fp header. Missing emitters are older proxies in eu-west-1.

tom: SQL to spot dup candidates (we used this):
```
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) as cnt, array_agg(distinct route) as routes
FROM metering_events
WHERE invoice_window = '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Most high-count fingerprints had >1 route in routes array.

priya: Backfill: run a job that scans historical finalize events and marks a canonical_fp for earlier stream events where we can infer identity, then re-ingest deduped deltas into preview. We'll need ops + finance approvals for mass credits.

dan: console/UX asks: add a per-route "dedupe_mode" indicator in invoice preview (v1/v2) and a metric for dup_candidate_rate. Finance wants to see % of fingerprints with >1 event before flipping.

finance-bot: tagging finance-ops: please review potential credit adjustment runbooks if backfill changes previews.

maya: short emergency stopgap: implement time-window dedupe in aggregator: if same fingerprint seen within 45s, suppress second event regardless of route. Turned on only as kill-switch.

nate: I'll coordinate canary cohort definitions and ensure preview emails are blocked for canary tenants until we confirm deltas.

priya: I'll open the aggregator PR today: add canonical_fingerprint field, dedupe_schema_version flag, and a feature flag to enable canonical deduping. Tests will include mixed-route scenario and shadow compare.

tom: post-rollout monitor: add telemetry: dup_candidate_rate, finalize_lag_histogram, and canary_delta_percent. Hook alerts if canary_delta > 0.2% or dup_candidate_rate increases after flip.

maya: thanks. Action items summary: priya -> PR + tests + docs; nate -> canary cohort + block preview emails; tom -> telemetry panels and SQL dashboards; dan -> backfill plan + credit flow with finance; ops/ingest to patch eu-west proxies emitting v3 header.

priya: timeline: PRs today, canary deploy 08:00 UTC tomorrow, observe 12h then decide. Backfill planning in parallel.

maya: go/no-go updates here please. If anyone sees anomalous invoice spikes outside canary, ping paging list.

nate: noted. will post canary assignment and initial metrics here once live.

maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
